resources.name: Quantum chemistry software (e.g., ORCA, NWChem, Psi4)

access.notes: Any DFT code capable of B3LYP/6-311G(d,p) calculations is acceptable.
SF5 volume 82 Å³; other atom volumes (C, H, N, F) will be provided in the instruction.
SMILES or initial 3D coordinates will be provided directly in the task instructions.
